name: Edgewall
description: The town where Kellan and Ruby return and find the Slumber's violet threads everywhere.

description_citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
description_citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: After failing to invade Edgewall, Lord Skitter's rats presumably devour him and the rats return to normal.
timeline.quote: After failing to invade Edgewall, his rats presumably devoured him

citation.text: "Rat", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rankle goes to the charm shop in Edgewall, smashes potions and demands a love potion from the hidden witch.
timeline.quote: Rankle smashed the bottle on the floor.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The witch freezes Rankle in mid-air, says she is leaving to join forces against the coming doom, and offers him a choice; he chooses the quest for a love flower.
timeline.quote: "We're joining forces to fight the doom that's coming."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan asks around Edgewall for witches and is warned by Ruby not to touch a sleeper because of the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: "The Wicked Slumber spreads, though no one's really sure how,"

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby agrees to guide Kellan to Dunbarrow in exchange for help finding her brother Peter, after he vaguely names his fae liege.
timeline.quote: "All right. I guess someone's got to look out for you, and it might as well be me."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby return to Edgewall to find the Slumber's violet threads spreading across the town.
timeline.quote: Now, with a sinking heart, Kellan realizes that the victims are beyond counting.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter agrees to take them to Loch Larent, warning them to turn back if they cannot feel their noses, and Ruby promises.
timeline.quote: "You must wear my thickest cloak, and when you can no longer feel your nose, you must turn back.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter shows them a puppet show of a girl in a red hood defeating a witch, moving Ruby.
timeline.quote: All watch in perfect stillness as two puppets triumph over all manner of trouble to defeat an evil, man-eating witch.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

relations.quote: Loch Larent lies a long week's journey from Edgewall.
